{{SW|url=news/star-wars-beyond-victory-announce|text=''Star Wars: Beyond Victory - A Mixed Reality Playset'' from ILM &ndash; Exclusive Reveal}} establishes that [[Star Wars: Beyond Victory - A Mixed Reality Playset|''Star Wars: Beyond Victory'' - A Mixed Reality Playset]] takes place around the time of the events of ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'', which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[10 BBY]]. {{#if:{{{comic|}}}|[[Beyond Victory 1|''Beyond Victory'' 1]] is set shortly before the events of the game. Therefore, ''Beyond Victory'' 1{{#if: {{{1|}}}|, including {{{1}}},|}} must take place around 10 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].|Therefore, ''Star Wars: Beyond Victory''{{#if: {{{1|}}}|, including {{{1}}},|}} must take place around 10 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]].}}<noinclude>
